guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Eclipse decisions, safe area damage, mana control, dungeon utility, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: Lunar
mechanics.use: Trigger Lunar Eclipse with Wrath, then protect the Starfire window from movement and needless refreshes.

mechanics.label: Solar
mechanics.use: Trigger Solar Eclipse with Starfire, then cast Wrath while using Starfall only where its radius is safe.

mechanics.label: DoTs
mechanics.use: Maintain Moonfire and Insect Swarm only when the target will live long enough for their useful ticks.

mechanics.label: Mana and movement
mechanics.use: Plan mana recovery, movement globals, positioning, utility, and safe returns to the Eclipse engine.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Eclipse baseline
talent.summary: Use the fully allocated dungeon-and-solo baseline for complete Eclipse, Starfall, hit, and mana support. Treat raid-only damage swaps as later progression.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Moonkin Form, Eclipse basics, safe Starfall use, hit assumptions, and a dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Manage Eclipse, DoTs, cooldowns, movement, mana, target life, crowd control, and Druid utility as one decision system.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 55/0/16 build, glyphs, original-client macros, addons, and Eclipse tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build hit deliberately, then balance spell power, haste, critical strike, Spirit, budget gems, and enchants.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle Eclipse windows, movement, target swaps, utility assignments, and encounter responsibilities by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Eclipse timing, Starfall targeting, treant pathing, Typhoon knockback, and encounter-specific immunities on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
